original_run.scope_note: Pinned notebook settings; 15-digit requested goal, working precision150, adaptive initial order40. Native requested20 digits uses higher effective truncation requirements. profile.finding: Most sampled arithmetic descends from exact Series<AtomField>::rpow inside local root-chart construction. The replacement reuses the existing rational Taylor solver for r_i prime=(R_i prime/(2R_i))*r_i and keeps branch, square and defect checks.

accuracy_policy.source_boundary: Finite-accuracy zeros retained with original per-coefficient metadata and a conservative1e-130 inexact-input absolute uncertainty floor. Low-level transport does not provide a propagated boundary-error certificate.

performance_conclusion: The optimized native chart implementation completes and agrees with the references. The cheaper native profile completed transport in59.553 seconds versus89.440 seconds for the original notebook run, with all65 native coefficients stable to1.880e-31 against the refined result and original-to-ancillary error6.168e-23. Single runs, different precision/order/accuracy settings, paths and step counts; no matched-settings or statistical speedup ratio is claimed.
phase_note: Original matrix construction forms the logarithmic canonical matrix; native symbolic construction forms all six exact physical derivative matrices and pulls them back. Native transport timing excludes this20-second setup. The original public TransportTo call can include its own line preprocessing. Cold end-to-end timings are recorded separately; no equal-work phase assumption is made.

reproduction.oracle_harness_validation: Wolfram held syntax parse passed. No new oracle timing claimed.
reproduction.test_scope_note: The production regression adds fixture-only assertions that every prescribed zero is matched and any colliding prescriptions agree; the timed standalone driver did not include these assertions. The route and numerical inputs are unchanged for this fixture.
